guard: a delegation refusal that cannot copy a row's real ACLs names the two flags and their wide default in prose, and prints no runnable command carrying values it invented
why: A spawner's own ACL is the CEILING every agent beneath it is attenuated against, so the repair for
a broken delegation chain decides that ceiling. Both arms of this branch got it wrong in different
ways: the missing-spawner arm printed `--scope spawn` and stopped, and the revoked-spawner arm
printed no flags at all, on the one path where `cotal actor list` cannot help because the revoke
There is no row to copy ACLs from on either arm, which is why the fix here is not the same as the
elevated-view one. A printed command carrying invented channel names fails on paste and pushes the
operator toward deleting the flags, and a deleted flag is `>`. So this refusal names the flags and
the default in prose and prints a command with NO ACL values at all. S2 is the mutant that proves
the difference: it puts a plausible fake value back and the prose stays correct.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. The suite imports the ledger by relative source path (../src/index.js), so the
mutated file is the file that runs and there is no build in the command.

mutations.name: S1 the shipped text: the missing-spawner repair names --scope and stops
mutations.find: ? `spawner "${parentKey}"${deep ? ` (an ancestor of "${leaf}")` : ""} has no grant in this space - delegation flows from a granted spawner chain; grant it first with \`cotal actor grant ${pActor} --owner ${pOwner} --scope spawn\`, and DECIDE its --allow-subscribe and --allow-publish rather than leaving them off: an omitted flag is the WIDE default (\`>\` read, \`>\` post), and a spawner's own ACL is the ceiling every agent spawned under it is attenuated against. No command is printed with those two filled in because there is no row to copy them from and this refusal will not invent them`

mutations.cell: the missing-spawner refusal names both ACL flags and the wide default they fall back to
mutations.note: Byte-for-byte the shipped string. The row is still refused, the refusal still names the missing spawner, and the `has no grant in this space` needle the neighbouring cell matches on is untouched.
